## Initial 26.1.2 Release (1.0.0)

- Ported Throwing Disc Legacy to Minecraft 26.1.2 NeoForge (Java 25) with full feature parity.
- Includes 5 tiers of Throwing Discs (Copper, Iron, Golden, Diamond, Netherite), solid surface ricochets, shield/entity deflection, multi-target piercing, dispenser launching, and direct steady-speed boomerang return.
- Includes the slot-reserving placeholder item (`disc_placeholder`) and all 6 custom enchantments (Ricochet, Tailwind, Returning Edge, Magnetic Recall, Cleaving Harvest, Vein Harvest).
- Updated client item definitions, recipe formats, rendering pipeline, and Enchantment Descriptions compatibility.

---

## 26.1.2 首个正式版本（1.0.0）

- 完整迁移至 Minecraft 26.1.2 NeoForge（Java 25），保留全部原有机制与特性。
- 包含 5 种材质投掷圆盘（铜、铁、金、钻石、下界合金）、表面弹射、盾牌/实体偏转、多目标穿透、发射器发射与直线匀速返回。
- 包含防抢手栏位占位物品，以及全部 6 个专属附魔（弹射、疾旋、回旋斩、磁吸召回、旋刃采掘、连锁采集）。
- 完成 26.1.2 客户端物品定义、配方格式、实体渲染管线以及附魔描述（Enchantment Descriptions）兼容适配。
